order: Correct the P0 Quartermaster's DEFAULT review-draw forecast under ruling R4. The prior derivation sustained the PEAK arrival rate across a full 168h week to reach mandatoryReviewDraw = 0.504, pushing the default requiredReserve to ~0.6552, so the P15 gate fired on nearly any bucket. That fabricates load. Replace the default with the directly MEASURED weekly draw of 0.03, leave incidentDraw at 0 as a disclosed under-estimate, and preserve the rejected peak-derived arithmetic in the comments as the cautionary alternative. Since 0.03 x 1.3 = 0.039 sits below the plan's own 8% floor, the floor governs the default. Touch only defaultForecast() and its ruling-R4 comment block, the README's R4 section, and the pinned R4 test values, where you should also add a check that the floor rather than the dynamic term governs. Every other behaviour of the seat must survive unchanged — the override path, the freshness rules, the fail-closed refusals, the confirmation protocol, the throttle-prediction method and the report output.
claims: defaultForecast() now returns the measured 0.03 draw, and the rejected peak-derived arithmetic (0.504, ~0.6552) is preserved in the comments as the cautionary alternative, computed but unused. The README's R4 section records both derivations and notes the override path is unaffected. Pinned values were updated (0.504 to 0.03, 0.6552 to the 0.08 floor), with an explicit check that the floor, not the 0.039 dynamic term, governs the default. Both suites are green — node tests/quartermaster.test.js reports 154 passed and node tests/router.test.js reports 135 passed.
